headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins in a 7-0 shutout, with Zack Wheeler leading the way on the mound. Wheeler pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Corey Seager being placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. The Texas Rangers shortstop's move is retroactive to June 12, 2026. Other notable injuries include Grayson Rodriguez (Los Angeles Angels) with low back inflammation, Jorge Polanco (New York Mets) with a right wrist contusion, and Carlos Estévez (Kansas City Royals) with a left foot contusion.

Several teams made roster moves, with the Kansas City Royals acquiring RHP Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, while the Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Marlins Fall to Phillies in Dominant 7-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a convincing 7-0 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Zack Wheeler leading the way on the mound. Wheeler pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Dylan Crews leading the charge at the plate. Crews hit a crucial home run, scoring two runs and driving in three, while Andrew Alvarez pitched 4 strong innings with 5 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Mets Suffer Shutout Loss in Cincinnati**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets fell to the Cincinnati Reds 12-0, marking a tough outing for the team. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Shut Out Padres 3-0**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres, winning 3-0. Dustin May pitched a complete game for the Cardinals, allowing no earned runs and striking out nine batters.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to June 12, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring RHP Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash.
